# تِكله TKLH

> منصة سعودية لتنسيق الحفلات وحفلات الزواج وإدارة وتنسيق المؤتمرات وحجز القاعات والضيافة والتصوير في الرياض وجدة والدمام.

TKLH (tklh.sa) is a Saudi platform connecting customers with vetted vendors for weddings, private events, and corporate conferences. Payments are held in escrow until the event is delivered. Bilingual (Arabic / English) with full RTL support.

## Pages

- [الرئيسية / Home](/): Overview of TKLH services, featured vendors, and pricing packages.
- [تنسيق زواج / Weddings](/weddings): Wedding planning, kosha design, halls, catering, and photography in KSA.
- [تنسيق حفلات / Events](/events): Graduation parties, birthdays, corporate events, and private celebrations.
- [إدارة وتنسيق مؤتمرات / Conferences](/conferences): Conference management, registration, AV, live streaming, and corporate events.

## Optional

- [شروط الاستخدام / Terms](/terms): Platform terms of service.
- [سياسة الخصوصية / Privacy](/privacy): Data and privacy policy.
- [سياسة الاسترجاع / Refunds](/refund-policy): Refund and escrow policy.
